retired_original.title: Design explicit premise operators and prerequisite composition without changing current source syntax
retired_original.why: The card implements only conjunction-only opaque atoms and neutral same-name attachments. Loader/build/runtime environments and dependencies are assigned formal propositions/catalogs; no new operator, typed predicate, evidence consumer or general dependency-DAG source syntax is supplied. DISCHARGE: a separately frozen language/API design with total-or-reject grammar, explicit quantifier/prerequisite/evidence semantics, exact context/refutation propagation, Rust/Lean parity and its own source/provider/all-route validation. This is design-only follow-on work and cannot license truth transport or automatic Unsafe.

add.title: Adopt scoped premise flows through an explicitly checked production semantic consumer
add.why: PREMISE-FLOW-OPERATORS supplies executable AND/OR/positive-NOT/terminal syntax and proposed composition, exact source/model/graph/Context replay and independently checked finite source-witness integrations. It deliberately migrates no production flow clause, registers no global typed predicate and supplies no verdict/standing consumer. Missing capability: turn one exactly scoped production obligation into checked authority only under independently discharged complete antecedents, without treating a generic ProposedEvaluation or a finite fixture as universal source truth. DISCHARGE: select and freeze a bounded production declaration/property and eligible predicate family; establish exact source/model/prose/environment correspondence and complete scoped evidence, including every feasible program-path obligation; implement a total-or-reject checked consumer and dependency/invalidation rule with matching Rust/Lean, exact9-coordinate context and refutation controls; preserve legacy erasure/classification and validate intentional verdict movement through standing/provider/all-route evidence. Safe requires all relevant obligations; Unsafe still requires a validated reachable C violation. Existing CJSON-REPRESENTATION-PROSE-AND-SOURCE-BINDING, LIBC-READING-PREMISES-TYPED-DISCHARGE, PLUGIN-PREMISE-SOURCE-BINDING and PLUGIN-PREMISE-OUTER-TRUTH retain their independent source/prose/world proof scopes.
